name: Cuenca, Ecuador

visa.notes: Retirement visa requires $1,375/mo income (3x Ecuador minimum wage). Includes discounts on utilities, flights, and entertainment.

rent.notes: 2BR unfurnished modern USD 500-750 (Cuenca High Life Dec 2025 via Rio Times); 2BR terrace ~750 (IL June 2026); CityCost 3BR USD 636-747. Pet-friendly house typical ~700.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of living Cuenca Ecuador expats 2026

groceries.notes: CityCost per-person grocery budget USD 210 x2 = ~420; INEC basic basket USD 828 for a family of 4 (Aug 2026). Large-dog food not separately verified.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of living Cuenca Ecuador expats 2026

utilities.notes: Electricity ~USD 0.10/kWh, 50% older-adult discount to 138 kWh, 50% water discount to 34 m3 (ETAPA bill incl. trash); no AC needed. CityCost 2BR utilities ~USD 39. Excludes internet.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of living Cuenca Ecuador expats 2026

healthcare.notes: Resident couple: IESS voluntary affiliation 17.6% of declared income, min USD 84.83/mo in 2026 (spouse add-on ~3.41%, couple ~USD 88-101) plus a local private plan (SaludSA ~USD 70-72/mo at age 60; BMI 2026 quote USD 186.61 for a 53-yo couple). Typical = IESS couple + local private for two; max = international cover. Carries full health cost (insurance re-modeled).

sources.title: Vistazo - Aportes IESS suben en 2026 (SBU USD 482)

transportation.notes: Bus USD 0.30, tram USD 0.30-0.35, monthly pass ~USD 16 each, taxis; max covers own car (fuel USD 3.175/gal Oct 2026).

entertainment.notes: Internet 50+ Mbps ~USD 27 + streaming + mid-range dinner for two ~USD 30 several times/mo + activities.

phoneCell.notes: Mobile plan (calls + 10GB+) ~USD 13.14/line x2; max for larger postpaid plans.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: Cuenca GP USD 30-40, Santa Ines USD 35, Monte Sinai USD 55, specialists USD 40-80; plus plan co-pays.

sources.title: Rio Times - Cost of living Cuenca Ecuador expats 2026

healthcare.system: IESS public system; good private hospitals (Hospital Monte Sinaí). Affordable private care.
healthcare.waitTimes: Short at private; moderate at IESS public
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Affordable; many meds available without prescription

pros: Very affordable with USD currency (no exchange risk)

cons.text: Altitude (8,400 ft) may cause adjustment issues
Cool climate may not suit warm-weather seekers
Political instability and occasional unrest in Ecuador
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

taxes.notes: Ecuador uses USD. Income tax on worldwide income if fiscal resident, but retiree visa holders may qualify for exemptions. Progressive rates 0-37%. Jubilado discount benefits offset many costs.
